title: BBox DocVQA: A Large Scale Bounding Box Grounded Dataset for Enhancing Reasoning in Document Visual Question Answer
abstract: Provides document VQA data with explicit bounding-box grounding for supporting evidence. It covers evidence involving one or multiple regions and documents, making it directly relevant to region-level provenance rather than page-only retrieval.

title: PDFFigures 2.0: Mining Figures from Research Papers
abstract: Extracts figures, tables, captions, and their locations from scholarly PDFs. Its explicit association of visual objects with captions and page regions is relevant to preserving object-level provenance during document ingestion.
